reconciled_benchmarks.notes: Evaluates only projection MLP and ordinal linear layer. Unrealistic for deployed pipeline.
True deployable pipeline with ConvNeXt-Tiny feature extraction in half precision.
Full precision pipeline suffers thermal/bandwidth bottleneck at BS=32.

verdict.disclosure_requirement: Claims of >100,000 FPS must be explicitly retracted or clarified as head-only evaluation on precomputed feature tensors. True end-to-end industrial throughput is 31.2 FPS (BS=1) to 75.6 FPS (BS=32), which still comfortably satisfies the real-time requirements of mechanical grading lines.
